messages:
Aisha (CS): FYI — UK Insureco just pushed a DPA clarification asking for local data residency for embeddings and a short retention window for PII-derived vectors. They flagged renewal unless we confirm options by EOD. :warning:
Tom (Solutions Eng): ack. Do they need full on‑prem or just region pinning (AWS eu-west-2)?
Aisha (CS): Quote from them: 'No cross-border copies of identifiable vectors; short TTL for any customer-specific embeddings; ability to rotate keys and prove deletion.' They asked if Redwood Dedicated or Private is required.
Sam (Security): We can do region pinning on Hosted with strict KMS + no cross-region replication for embeddings store, but we need to validate our backup/replication configs. Also need to confirm replay/proxy logs.
Jules (Legal): We should propose DPA language options: (1) Hosted with EU residency + contractual assurance + audit right, (2) Dedicated with committed capacity + contractual residency and BYOK, (3) Private (VPC/on‑prem) for strictest cases. We need a short note on deletion proof (evidence).
Tom (Solutions Eng): Technical note for CS to share (copy/paste):
```
- Hosted EU: embeddings stored in eu-west-2, KMS-managed keys scoped to account, search index TTL configurable via API (example: ttl_seconds=259200 for 3 days). Backups disabled for this tenant; async snapshots retained only in-region.
- Dedicated: customer GPUs with isolated object store, optional BYOK via KMS import, full control over replication.
- Private: deployable package; air-gapped option available.
```
Aisha (CS): Nice. Can you add the API snippet for TTL? They asked for exact call we support.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Sure — snippet: `POST /v1/embeddings/indices/my-index/retention {"ttl_seconds":259200}`. Also add note: `admin:rotate_key()` supports KMS key rotation; we will deliver rotation log for audit window.
Sam (Security): Two asks before we signal Hosted is ok: 1) Confirm backups are disabled for that tenant (ops ticket), 2) Provide sample audit log showing key rotations and deletion events. I can pull sample logs with redaction.
Aisha (CS): I'll tell the customer we can do Hosted EU with constraints pending security verification. Timeline: Ops ticket for backups/status by 2pm, Sam to attach sample redacted logs by 4pm, Jules to draft DPA addendum by COB. If we miss EOD, customer may request Dedicated pricing which delays renewal.
Jules (Legal): Drafting addendum now — will include a deletion attestation clause and BYOK language for Dedicated/Private.
OnboardBot: Ticket created — OPS-4821 "Verify backups and replication settings for eu-west-2 tenant (Insureco)" assigned to eng-infra.
Tom (Solutions Eng): Quick follow-up — embeddings pseudonymization pattern we've used before: salt + one-way hash before vectorization. That reduces PII risk and might satisfy their legal team. Shall I include as recommendation?
Aisha (CS): Yes include as recommended option (low-friction), but mark as "may impact retrieval quality".
Sam (Security): Agree. Also propose a short customer checklist to close the ask: 1) Select deployment option, 2) Accept addendum, 3) Confirm TTL & pseudonymization, 4) Provide any PS scheduling for Dedicated/private.
Aisha (CS): I'll send the checklist + Tom's snippets to the customer in a single email thread. Will update here after ops/Legal deliverables. :pray:
Tom (Solutions Eng): Ping me if they want sample config or a short demo of TTL change via Console.
Jules (Legal): Uploaded initial addendum draft to Google Drive: https://drive.reddemo/example — comments welcome.
Sam (Security): Uploaded redacted rotation log sample to the ticket.
Aisha (CS): Update: Ops confirmed backups disabled for tenant at 13:42. Sending hosted EU proposal now.
Aisha (CS): Customer replied — "Hosted EU with pseudonymization and 7-day TTL acceptable, please send DPA addendum." They want evidence of deletion within 30 days of request.
Jules (Legal): I'll add deletion attestation timeline (30 days) and a one-time certified deletion report.
Aisha (CS): Thanks team — this looks like a win for renewal as long as addendum lands tomorrow. Closing internal loop here, will move to customer thread. :tada:
